Durga Saptashati Path / Havan

₹4,200 onwards3–4 hrs

Durga Saptashati Path involves the complete recitation of the 700 sacred verses glorifying Goddess Durga, invoking her protection, strength, and victory over obstacles. The path concludes with a havan where offerings are made to Agni, sealing the blessings invoked during the recitation.
